# Quit App

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Quit's the provided app

## Syntax

~~~~text
quitApp(app: <#App#>, askToSave: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
quitApp(app: com.zlineman.jellyfish, askToSave: true)
~~~~
